paths.descriptionEn: Build every component of a Transformer from scratch — activations, normalization, attention, and the full GPT-2 block.
paths.descriptionZh: 从零构建 Transformer 的每个组件——激活函数、归一化、注意力机制到完整的 GPT-2 Block。

paths.descriptionEn: Master every attention variant and position encoding technique — from scaled dot-product to Flash Attention, RoPE, and ALiBi.
paths.descriptionZh: 掌握所有注意力变体和位置编码技术——从缩放点积到 Flash Attention、RoPE 和 ALiBi。

paths.descriptionEn: Build and train a complete GPT — from embeddings and transformer blocks to Adam, cosine LR, and mixed precision.
paths.descriptionZh: 构建并训练完整的 GPT——从 Embedding 和 Transformer Block 到 Adam、余弦学习率和混合精度。

paths.descriptionEn: Speed up inference with KV cache, quantization, and decoding strategies. Scale training with tensor parallelism, FSDP, and ring attention.
paths.descriptionZh: 通过 KV Cache、量化和解码策略加速推理。用张量并行、FSDP 和环形注意力扩展训练规模。

paths.descriptionEn: Implement the loss functions and search algorithms behind modern alignment — from reward modeling and DPO to PPO with GAE, GRPO, and MCTS.
paths.descriptionZh: 实现现代对齐背后的损失函数和搜索算法——从奖励建模和 DPO 到内置 GAE 的 PPO、GRPO 和 MCTS。

paths.descriptionEn: Implement the cutting-edge attention and routing mechanisms powering DeepSeek, Meta, and Microsoft's latest models.
paths.descriptionZh: 实现驱动 DeepSeek、Meta 和微软最新模型的前沿注意力与路由机制。

paths.descriptionEn: Build the machinery of a tool-using agent from the inside — ReAct traces, Qwen-style tool-call parsing, schema validation, multi-turn loss masks, context budgeting, KV reuse, and memory retrieval.
paths.descriptionZh: 从内部构建一个会使用工具的 agent 的全部机制——ReAct 轨迹、Qwen 式工具调用解析、Schema 校验、多轮损失掩码、上下文预算、KV 复用与记忆检索。

paths.descriptionEn: Move knowledge from a big teacher into a small student — classic KD, top-k and hidden-state variants, then the on-policy frontier: reverse KL on the student's own rollouts, OPSD-style self-distillation from a privileged view of the same model, action-level agent distillation, and MiMo-style multi-teacher blending.
paths.descriptionZh: 把大教师的知识迁移进小学生——经典 KD、top-k 与隐状态变体，再到在线策略前沿：学生自己 rollout 上的反向 KL、OPSD 式同模型特权视图自蒸馏、动作级 agent 蒸馏，以及 MiMo 式多教师融合。

paths.descriptionEn: Dissect how the strong open-weight families are actually built — Qwen, GLM, Kimi, DeepSeek and Xiaomi MiMo: QK-Norm, YaRN, partial RoPE, MoE routing tricks, hybrid sliding-window attention, delta-rule linear layers, and the Muon optimizer.
paths.descriptionZh: 拆解最强开源模型家族的真实构造——Qwen、GLM、Kimi、DeepSeek 与小米 MiMo：QK-Norm、YaRN、部分 RoPE、MoE 路由技巧、混合滑窗注意力、delta 规则线性层，以及 Muon 优化器。
